recipes.intention: Call a service that requires a credential and scopes (authorization client)
primitives: go.putnami.dev/client: Services() binding carrying the credential values
antiPatterns: A hand-written client struct that sets the Authorization header itself
A custom middleware that parses credentials instead of security.IdentityResolver
Credential header names repeated in consumer code instead of the provider's credential profiles

recipes.intention: Generate a typed HTTP client for a provider service
primitives: generated client: RegisterItemsClient(module) with go.putnami.dev/client: Services()
antiPatterns: A net/http wrapper with request and response structs copied by hand
An edit inside a generated clients/ tree instead of a regeneration
A base URL, header or retry loop written in the consumer

recipes.intention: Run tests against a real database
primitives: infra/requirements.json databases entry (putnami test provisions the binding)
antiPatterns: A per-package dbtest.go that hardcodes a connection string or starts its own container
A shared long-lived test database that each test cleans up by hand
Schema DDL run from application startup code
A manual file walk or registry call per feature in cmd/ binaries
A polling loop or a channel shared between features
An untyped payload decoded by hand in the subscriber
